==Overview==
The '''AfreecaTV StarCraft League BroodWar Season 1''' or '''2016 AfreecaTV StarLeague Season 1''', was an offline tournament organized and broadcast live on [[AfreecaTV]].<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20160615065329/http://starleague.kr/ Starleague announcement page, archived]</ref> 

The Starleague was announced on June 15, 2016 with two open offline qualifiers scheduled for Seoul and Busan on June 25 and 26, 2016, respectively.

The grand final of the tournament was held at Seoul Children's Grand Park alongside 2016 GSL Code S Season 2 Finals (StarCraft 2).<ref>[https://tl.net/forum/starcraft-2/513726-gsl-and-asl-finals-venue-information]</ref><br>

<embedvideo service="youtube">https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ztmD4KlClD0</embedvideo>

===Format===
;Preliminary Qualifiers
*14 groups of 32-128 players each, seven groups in each of Seoul and Busan
*Single-elimination bracket: best-of-three
*Winner of each group advances

;Round of 16 Group Stage
*Group selection: July 10, 2016 <!-- - 19:00 {{Abbr/KST}}--> [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=td-12J0YmqI VOD]
*Four groups of four players each
<!--*[[Dual tournament]] format: best-of-one-->
*Top two players in each group advance

;Elimination Stage
*Eight player single-elimination bracket
*Quarterfinals through finals: best-of-five
